verdicts.reason: A is just the original portrait layout shrunk into a tiny island in the middle of the banner. Every piece of text, the cards and the CTA are unreadable specks surrounded by empty grey, so it is unusable. B properly reflows the design for a banner: logo, plan cards, a large headline and a prominent orange CTA. Its flaws are that the subtitle under the logo, the card labels and the legal line under the headline are illegibly small, the card order is changed (6, 80, 48), so the dark Yearly card moves from the centre to the end, and the left cluster is cramped.
